friction_events.description: Three bounded authority CREATE attempts hit proven existing claim paths; unbatched launch had no tail-rescue authority.

decision_trace.decision: Created a de-novo v3.30 beacon before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: WORKER_FRESH_LAUNCH_POLICY_V1 requires atomic fresh beacon creation as the first durable worker write.

decision_trace.decision: Stopped after the ordinary three-attempt authority budget was exhausted.
decision_trace.observable_basis: All three CREATE attempts returned the canonical existing-path signature and this invocation was unbatched, so POOL_TAIL_RESCUE did not apply.
decision_trace.action: Persisted a no-allocation boundary receipt with STOP_NO_RECOVERY.
decision_trace.outcome: No authority was acquired and no historical claim was reused.

top_time_sinks.note: Bounded collision handling consumed the launch without producing authority.

unfinished_debt.item: No owned product objective was executed because E2 never produced authority.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Reduce stale/crowded claim hints reaching fresh unbatched workers without increasing the authority-attempt ceiling.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Fewer launches terminate entirely in proven CREATE_EXISTS contention.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 worker launched correctly, but all three bounded authority claims collided with existing ownership. No job authority was acquired; a durable NO_ALLOCATION boundary was recorded and the worker closed without reusing historical identity or results.
